EXPOSURE.not_applicable: not measured -- this position has no startable slot in this league

DISPLACEMENT.not_applicable: not measured -- this position has no startable slot in this league
DISPLACEMENT.no_points_anchor: not measured -- this position has no replacement level in projected points here

DENIAL.no_intervening_rival: no rival had a pick before your next turn
